items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glaser had Cal Dickerson. He was going to open the Sunset, so he hired Cal Dickerson to get the band. So Cal Dickerson was picking out the men... Louis told Joe... you gotta have Randolph... Joe was giving me a job, because he's going to have me to organize the band for Louis.

ctx.x: Joe Glaser had Cal Dickerson. He was going to open the Sunset, so he hired Cal Dickerson to get the band. So Cal Dickerson was picking out the men. Louis told Joe that he was coming to town, you know, he was coming back, and as near as I can remember, now, he had -- he told Cal Dickerson to -- whoever you put on -- I don't care who else you have on trumpet, but you gotta have Randolph.
But I didn't know at the time that Louis had told Joe to have -- to put me in the band. So when Joe Glaser came to hear the band -- this was funny, so he featured everybody in the band but me.
